frame.runs_fingerprint_rule: sha1 over path:mtime_ns:size of the consumed *.eval_results.json files (since 2026-09-02; before: every file under runs/)
frame.inputs_content_rule:
sha256 (first 12 hex) of the UTF-8 bytes of lines `<arm>	<task>	<passes>	<attempts>
` for every consumed cell (every sampled arm, kept tasks only; arm = the fail matrix's `model` column literal; passes = attempts - fails, fails counted under plus_status), lines sorted as plain strings by (arm, task) — reproducible from artifacts/fail_counts_matrix.csv; reference script data/inputs_content_sha.py
frame.rebuild_condition: re-pulls when the failure-vs-difficulty page's board handoff changes (each landing) or the Bayesian/capability_C chains re-emit; frame is a snapshot at build_ts

axis_reuse: median chain REUSES the average chain's difficulty axis (declared, not silent)
